explanation: The act where Jesus washed the disciples' feet as a symbol of humility, service, and cleansing from sin.
The quality of being humble and not looking down on others; demonstrated through Jesus' action of washing feet.
To perform work for the sake of others without expecting personal gain, as Jesus encouraged his disciples to do following his example.
The message to love one another just as Jesus loved them; the core of his new commandment before the crucifixion.
The act where Judas Iscariot betrayed Jesus, which was revealed during the meal when he took the bread after Jesus had given it to him.
When Peter refused to let Jesus wash his feet, this showed his lack of understanding of Jesus' purpose in the action.
God's favor and grace expressed through words or actions; here linked to the disciples' purity after the foot washing.
